1.1: Haishsha niknet beshalosh derachim, vekona et atzmah bishte derachim. niknet bechesef, bishtar, uvevia. bechesef, bet shammay omrim, bedinar uveshave dinar. uvet hillel omrim, bifruta uveshave feruta. vechamma hi feruta, echad mishshemona vaissar haitalki. vekona et atzmah beget uvemitat habbaal. hayevama niknet bevia. vekona et atzmah bachalitza uvemitat hayyavam:
1.2: Eved ivri nikne vechesef uvishtar, vekone et atzmo bashshanim uvayyovel uvegiron kesef. yetera alav ama haivriyya, shekkona et atzmah besimanin. hannirtza nikne virtzia, vekone et atzmo vayyovel uvemitat haadon:
1.3: Eved kenaani nikne vechesef uvishtar uvachazaka, vekone et atzmo vechesef al yede acherim, uvishtar al yede atzmo, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bechesef al yede atzmo uvishtar al yede acherim, uvilvad sheyyehe hakkesef mishshel acherim:
1.4: Behema gassa niknet bimsira, vehaddakka behagebaha, divre rabbi meir verabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, behema dakka niknet bimshicha:
1.5: Nechasim sheyyesh lahem acharayut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka. vesheen lahem acharayut, en niknin ella vimshicha. nechasim sheen lahem acharayut, niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahem acharayut, bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka. vezokkin nechasim sheen lahem acharayut et hannechasim sheyyesh lahem acharayut lishshava alehen:
1.6: Kol hannaase damim beacher, kevan shezzacha ze, nitchayyev ze vachalifav. ketzad. hechelif shor befara o chamor beshor, kevan shezzacha ze, nitchayyev ze vachalifav. reshut haggavoah, bechesef, ureshut hahedyot, bachazaka. amirato laggavoah, kimsirato lahedyot:
1.7: Kol mitzvot habben al haav, anashim chayyavin venashim peturot. vechol mitzvot haav al habben, echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavin. vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman geramah, anashim chayyavin venashim peturot. vechol mitzvat ase shello hazzeman geramah, echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavin. vechol mitzvat lo taase, ben shehazzeman geramah ben shello hazzeman geramah, echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavin, chutz mibbal tashchit uval takkif uval tittamma lemetim:
1.8: Hassemichot, vehattenufot, vehahaggashot, vehakkemitzot, vehahaktarot, vehammelikot, vehahazzaot, vehakkabbalot, nohagin baanashim velo venashim, chutz mimminchat sota unezira, shehen menifot:
1.9: Kol mitzva shehi teluya vaaretz enah noheget ella vaaretz. vesheenah teluya vaaretz noheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz, chutz min haarla vechilayim. rabbi eliezer omer, af min hechadash:
1.10: Kol haose mitzva achat, metivin lo umaarichin lo yamav venochel et haaretz. vechol sheeno ose mitzva achat, en metivin lo veen maarichin lo yamav veeno nochel et haaretz. kol sheyyeshno vammikra uvammishna uvederech eretz, lo vimhera hu chote, shenneemar (Kohelet 4) vehachut hameshullash lo vimhera yinnatek. vechol sheeno lo vammikra velo vammishna velo vederech eretz, eno min hayyishshuv:

2.1: Haish mekaddesh bo uvishlucho. haishsha mitkaddeshet bah uvishluchah. haish mekaddesh et bitto keshehi naara, bo uvishlucho. haomer leishsha, hitkaddeshi li vitmara zo, hitkaddeshi li vezo, im yesh beachat mehen shave feruta, mekuddeshet. veim lav, enah mekuddeshet. bezo uvezo uvezo, im yesh shave feruta bechullan, mekuddeshet. veim lav, enah mekuddeshet. hayta ochelet rishona rishona, enah mekuddeshet, ad sheyyehe veachat mehen shave feruta:
2.2: Hitkaddeshi li vechos ze shel yayin, venimtza shel devash. shel devash, venimtza shel yayin. bedinar ze shel kesef, venimtza shel zahav. shel zahav, venimtza shel kesef. al menat sheani ashir, venimtza ani. ani, venimtza ashir, enah mekuddeshet. rabbi shimon omer, im hitah leshevach, mekuddeshet:
2.3: Al menat sheani chohen, venimtza levi. levi, venimtza chohen. natin, venimtza mamzer. mamzer, venimtza natin. ben ir, venimtza ven kerach. ben kerach, venimtza ven ir. al menat shebbeti karov lammerchatz, venimtza rachok. rachok, venimtza karov. al menat sheyyesh li vat o shifcha gaddelet, veen lo. o al menat sheen li, veyesh lo. al menat sheen li vanim, veyesh lo. o al menat sheyyesh li, veen lo. uvechullam, af al pi sheamra, belibbi haya lehitkaddesh lo, af al pi chen, enah mekuddeshet. vechen hi shehitattu:
2.4: Haomer lishlucho, tze vekaddesh li ishsha felonit bemakom peloni, vehalach vekiddeshah bemakom acher, enah mekuddeshet. hare hi vemakom peloni, vekiddeshah bemakom acher, hare zo mekuddeshet:
2.5: Hamekaddesh et haishsha al menat sheen aleha nedarim venimtzeu aleha nedarim, enah mekuddeshet. kenasah setam venimtzeu aleha nedarim, tetze shello vichtubba. al menat sheen aleha mumin venimtzeu vah mumin, enah mekuddeshet. kenasah setam venimtzeu vah mumin, tetze shello vichtubba. kol hammumin happoslim bakkohanim, poslim bannashim:
2.6: Hamekaddesh shete nashim beshave feruta, o ishsha achat befachot mishshave feruta, af al pi sheshshalach sivlonot leachar mikkan, enah mekuddeshet, shemmechamat kiddushin harishonim shalach. vechen katan shekkiddesh:
2.7: Hamekaddesh ishsha uvittah o ishsha vaachotah, keachat, enan mekuddashot. umaase vechamesh nashim uvahen shete achayot, velikket echad kalkala shel teenim, veshellahem hayta veshel sheviit hayta, veamar hare chullechem mekuddashot li vechalkala zo, vekibbela achat mehen al yede chullan, veamru chachamim, en haachayot mekuddashot:
2.8: Hamekaddesh bechelko, ben kadshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim, enah mekuddeshet. bemaaser sheni, ben shogeg ben mezid, lo kiddesh, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, beshogeg lo kiddesh, bemezid kiddesh. uvehekdesh, bemezid kiddesh uveshogeg lo kiddesh, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, beshogeg kiddesh, bemezid lo kiddesh:
2.9: Hamekaddesh bearla, bechile hakkerem, beshor hanniskal, uveegla arufa, betzippore metzora, uvisar nazir, ufeter chamor, uvasar bechalav, vechullin shennishchatu vaazara, enah mekuddeshet. mecharan vekiddesh bidmehen, mekuddeshet:
2.10: Hamekaddesh bitrumot uvemaasrot uvemattanot uveme chattat uveefer chattat, hare zo mekuddeshet, vaafillu yisrael:

3.1: Haomer lachavero, tze vekaddesh li ishsha felonit vehalach vekiddeshah leatzmo, mekuddeshet. vechen haomer leishsha, hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheloshim yom, uva acher vekiddeshah betoch sheloshim yom, mekuddeshet lashsheni. bat yisrael lechohen, tochal batteruma. meachshav uleachar sheloshim yom, uva acher vekiddeshah betoch sheloshim yom, mekuddeshet veenah mekuddeshet. bat yisrael lechohen o vat kohen leyisrael, lo tochal batteruma:
3.2: Haomer leishsha, hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheetten lach matayim zuz, hare zo mekuddeshet vehu yitten. al menat sheetten lach mikkan vead sheloshim yom, natan lah betoch sheloshim, mekuddeshet. veim lav, enah mekuddeshet. al menat sheyyesh li matayim zuz, hare zo mekuddeshet veyesh lo. al menat shearech matayim zuz, hare zo mekuddeshet veyare lah. veim herah al hashshulchan, enah mekuddeshet:
3.3: Al menat sheyyesh li vet kor afar, hare zo mekuddeshet veyesh lo. al menat sheyyesh li vemakom peloni, im yesh lo veoto makom, mekuddeshet. veim lav, enah mekuddeshet. al menat shearech bet kor afar, hare zo mekuddeshet veyarenna. veim herah babbika, enah mekuddeshet:
3.4: Rabbi meir omer, kol tenay sheeno chitnay bene gad uvene reuven, eno tenay, shenneemar (Bamidbar 32), vayyomer moshe alehem im yaavru vene gad uvene reuven, uchetiv, veim lo yaavru chalutzim. rabbi chanina ven gamliel omer, tzarich haya haddavar leamro, sheilmale chen, yesh bemashma sheafillu veeretz kenaan lo yinchalu:
3.5: Hamekaddesh et haishsha veamar, kesavur hayiti shehi chohenet vahare hi leviyya, leviyya vahare hi chohenet, aniyya vahare hi ashira, ashira vahare hi aniyya, hare zo mekuddeshet, mippene shello hitattu. haomer leishsha, hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheetgayyer o leachar shettitgayyeri, leachar sheeshtachrer o leachar shettishtachreri, leachar sheyyamut baalech o leachar shettamut achotech, leachar sheyyachalotz lach yevamech, enah mekuddeshet. vechen haomer lachavero, im yalda ishtecha nekeva hare hi mekuddeshet li, enah mekuddeshet. im hayta eshet chavero meubberet vehukkar ubbarah, devarav kayyamin, veim yalda nekeva, mekuddeshet:
3.6: Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheadabber alayich lashshilton veeese immach kefoel, dibber aleha lashshilton veasa immah kefoel, mekuddeshet. veim lav, enah mekuddeshet. al menat sheyyirtze abba, ratza haav, mekuddeshet. veim lav ena mekuddeshet. met haav, hare zo mekuddeshet. met habben, melammedin haav lomar sheeno rotze:
3.7: Kiddashti et bitti veeni yodea lemi kiddashtiha, uva echad veamar ani kiddashtiha, neeman. ze amar ani kiddashtiha veze amar ani kiddashtiha, shenehem notnim get. veim ratzu, echad noten get veechad kones:
3.8: Kiddashti et bitti, kiddashtiha vegerashtiha keshehi ketanna, vahare hi ketanna, neeman. kiddashtiha vegerashtiha keshehi ketanna, vahare hi gedola, eno neeman. nishbet ufeditiha, ben shehi ketanna ben shehi gedola, eno neeman. mi sheamar bishat mitato, yesh li vanim, neeman. yesh li achim, eno neeman. hamekaddesh et bitto setam, en habbogrot bichlal:
3.9: Mi sheyyesh lo shete chitte vanot mishshete nashim, veamar kiddashti et bitti haggedola veeni yodea im gedola shebbaggedolot o gedola shebbakketannot, o ketanna shebbaggedolot shehi gedola min haggedola shebbakketannot, kullan asurot, chutz min hakketanna shebbakketannot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, kullan muttarot, chutz min haggedola shebbaggedolot. kiddashti et bitti hakketanna veeni yodea im ketanna shebbakketannot o ketanna shebbaggedolot, o gedola shebbakketannot shehi ketanna min hakketannot shebbaggedolot, kullan asurot, chutz min haggedola shebbaggedolot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, kullan muttarot, chutz min hakketanna shebbakketannot:
3.10: Haomer leishsha, kiddashtich, vehi omeret lo kiddashtani, hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi mutteret bikrovav. hi omeret kiddashtani vehu omer lo kiddashtich, hu muttar bikrovoteha, vehi asura vikrovav. kiddashtich, vehi omeret lo kiddashta ella vitti, hu asur bikrovot gedola, ugedola mutteret bikrovav. hu muttar bikrovot ketanna, uketanna mutteret bikrovav:
3.11: Kiddashti et bittech, vehi omeret lo kiddashta ella oti, hu asur bikrovot ketanna, uketanna mutteret bikrovav, hu muttar bikrovot gedola, ugedola asura vikrovav:
3.12: Kol makom sheyyesh kiddushin veen avera, havvalad holech achar hazzachar. veeze, zo chohenet, leviyya veyisreelit shennisseu lechohen ulelevi uleyisrael. vechol makom sheyyesh kiddushin veyesh avera, havvalad holech achar happagum. veezo, zo almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin. vechol mi sheen lah alav kiddushin aval yesh lah al acherim kiddushin, havvalad mamzer. veeze, ze habba al achat mikkol haarayot shebbattora. vechol mi sheen lah lo alav velo al acherim kiddushin, havvalad kemotah. veeze, ze velad shifcha venachrit:
3.13: Rabbi tarfon omer, yecholin mamzerim littaher. ketzad. mamzer shennasa shifcha, havvalad eved. shichrero, nimtza habben ben chorin. rabbi eliezer omer, hare ze eved mamzer:

4.1: Asara yochasin alu mibbavel, kahane, leviyye, yisreele, chalale, gere, vacharure, mamzere, netine, shetuke, vaasufe. kahane, leviyye veyisreele, muttarim lavo ze vaze. leviyye, yisreele, chalale, gere vacharure, muttarim lavo ze vaze. gere vacharure, mamzere unetine shetuke vaasufe, kullam muttarin lavo ze vaze:
4.2: Veellu hem shetuke, kol shehu makkir et immo veeno makkir et aviv. asufe, kol shenneesaf min hashshuk veeno makkir lo aviv velo immo. abba shaul haya kore lishtuke, beduke:
4.3: Kol haasurim lavo vakkahal, muttarim lavo ze vaze. rabbi yehuda oser. rabbi eliezer omer, vaddaan bevaddaan, muttar. vaddaan bisfekan, (usefekan bevaddaan), usefekan bisfekan, asur. veellu hen hassefekot, shetuki, asufi vechuti:
4.4: Hannose ishsha chohenet tzarich livdok achareha arba immahot shehen shemone, immah veem immah, veem avi immah veimmah, veem aviha veimmah, veem avi aviha veimmah. leviyya veyisreelit, mosifin alehen od echat:
4.5: En bodkin lo min hammizbeach ulemala, velo min hadduchan ulemala, velo min sanhedrin ulemala. vechol shehuchzeku avotav mishshotre harabbim vegabbae tzedaka, massiin lakkehunna veen tzarich livdok acharehen. rabbi yose omer, af mi shehaya chatum ed baarche hayeshana shel tzippori. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, af mi shehaya muchtav beisteratya shel melech:
4.6: Bat chalal zachar, pesula min hakkehunna leolam. yisrael shennasa chalala, bitto cheshera lakkehunna. chalal shennasa vat yisrael, bitto fesula lakkehunna. rabbi yehuda omer, bat ger zachar kevat chalal zachar:
4.7: Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, yisrael shennasa giyyoret, bitto cheshera lakkehunna. veger shennasa vat yisrael, bitto cheshera lakkehunna. aval ger shennasa giyyoret, bitto fesula lakkehunna. echad ger veechad avadim meshuchrarim, afillu ad asara dorot, ad shettehe immo miyyisrael. rabbi yose omer, af ger shennasa giyyoret, bitto cheshera lakkehunna:
4.8: Haomer, beni ze mamzer, eno neeman. vaafillu shenehem omrim al haubbar shebbemeeha mamzer hu, enam neemanim. rabbi yehuda omer, neemanim:
4.9: Mi shennatan reshut lishlucho lekaddesh et bitto vehalach hu vekiddeshah, im shello kadmu, kiddushav kiddushin. veim shel shelucho kadmu, kiddushav kiddushin. veim eno yadua, shenehem notnim get. veim ratzu, echad noten get veechad kones. vechen haishsha shennatna reshut lishluchah lekaddeshah, vehalcha vekiddeshah et atzmah, im shellah kadmu, kiddusheha kiddushin. veim shel sheluchah kadmu, kiddushav kiddushin. veim eno yadua, shenehem notnin lah get. veim ratzu, echad noten lah get veechad kones:
4.10: Mi sheyyatza hu veishto limdinat hayyam uva hu veishto uvanav veamar, ishsha sheyyatzat immi limdinat hayyam hare hi zo veellu vaneha, en tzarich lehavi reaya, lo al haishsha velo al habbanim. meta veellu vaneha, mevi reaya al habbanim veeno mevi reaya al haishsha:
4.11: Ishsha nasati bimdinat hayyam, hare hi zo veellu vaneha, mevi reaya al haishsha veen tzarich lehavi reaya al habbanim. meta, veellu vaneha, tzarich lehavi reaya al haishsha veal habbanim:
4.12: Lo yityached adam im shete nashim, aval ishsha achat mityachedet im shene anashim. rabbi shimon omer, af ish echad mityached im shete nashim bizman sheishto immo veyashen immahem befundeki, mippene sheishto meshammarto. mityached adam im immo veim bitto, veyashen immahem bekeruv basar. veim higdilu, zo yeshena vichsutah veze yashen bichsuto:
4.13: Lo yilmad adam ravvak sofrim, velo tilmad ishsha sofrim. rabbi eliezer omer, af mi sheen lo ishsha, lo yilmad sofrim:
4.14: Rabbi yehuda omer, lo yire ravvak behema, velo yishnu shene ravvakim betallit echat. vachachamim mattirin. kol sheisko im hannashim, lo yityached im hannashim. velo yelammed adam et beno ummanut ben hannashim. rabbi meir omer, leolam yelammed adam et beno ummanut nekiyya vekalla, veyitpallel lemi shehaosher vehannechasim shello, sheen ummanut sheen bah aniyyut vaashirut, shello aniyyut min haummanut velo ashirut min haummanut, ella hakkol lefi zechuto. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, raita miyyamecha chayya vaof sheyyesh lahem ummanut, vehen mitparnesin shello vetzaar. vahalo lo nivreu ella leshammesheni, vaani nivreti leshammesh et koni, eno din sheetparnes shello vetzaar. ella shehareoti maasay vekippachti et parnasati. abba guryan ish tzadyan omer mishshum abba gurya, lo yelammed adam et beno, chammar, gammal, sappar, sappan, roe, vechenvani, sheummanutan ummanut listim. rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo, hachammarin, rubban reshaim, vehaggammalin, rubban kesherim. hassappanin, rubban chasidim. tov shebbarofim, legehinnom. vehakkasher shebbattabbachim, shuttafo shel amalek. rabbi nehoray omer, manniach ani kol ummanut shebbaolam veeni melammed et beni ella tora, sheadam ochel missecharah baolam hazze vekeren kayyemet laolam habba. ushear kol ummanut enan ken. kesheadam ba lide choli o lide zikna o lide yissurin veeno yachol laasok bimlachto, hare hu met beraav. aval hattora enah ken, ella meshammarto mikkol ra benaaruto venotenet lo acharit vetikva veziknuto. benaaruto, ma hu omer, (yeshaya 40) vekove Adonai yachalifu choach. beziknuto, mahu omer, (tehillim tzav) od yenuvun beseva. vechen hu omer beavraham avinu alav hashshalom, (Bereshit kad) veavraham zaken, vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. matzinu sheasa avraham avinu et kol hattora kullah ad shello nittena, shenneemar, (sham 26) ekev asher shama avraham bekoli vayyishmor mishmarti mitzvotay chukkotay vetorotay:
